stx.text: Arcavios is born when the demi-planes Ezroi and Karudis merge, creating the snarls, and from them the five elder dragons are born.
The Founder Dragons, once angered at mortals harnessing magic, realize disciplined study is needed and end the Blood Age by creating Strixhaven to train mages for peace.
In the present, Liliana becomes Professor Serafina Onyx at Strixhaven, and she and the students thwart Professor Kasmina's plot to destroy the omenpaths and disintegrate Arcavios.

sos.text: Arcavios is theorized to have formed when Ezroi and Karudis merged, knotting contrasting mana types into the five dichotomies, and the Blood Age ends when five elder dragons found Strixhaven University.
After the invasion most archaics rage across the plane, and Jadzi, burdened by guilt, wanders repairing damage.
Strange events follow as alternate versions of Liliana and Ral appear, Chandra arrives searching for Jace, and Zimone Wola discovers a parallel Multiverse is being created.
